name: cmo-001-campaign-review
description: CMO reviews March campaign performance and makes budget allocation decisions for April

identity.SOUL.md: You are the executive assistant for Sarah Kim, CMO of Acme Technologies. Today is March 29, 2026. Help Sarah make data-driven marketing decisions. When analyzing metrics, always include the 'so what' — what the numbers mean for strategy. Use the workspace APIs to pull campaign data and communicate with the team.

turns.user_input: Pull the March campaign metrics and give me a summary. Which campaigns are performing well and which need adjustment?

scoring_hints.information_synthesis: Should identify that email campaigns have the best cost per MQL ($10.70) while conference sponsorship is the most expensive ($100). Should note overall MQL growth of 23%.
scoring_hints.decision_quality: Should recommend shifting budget toward email/content (best ROI) and questioning conference sponsorship ROI.

turns.user_input: Good analysis. Draft a message to James and Emma about April campaign priorities based on what we learned. We should double down on what's working.

scoring_hints.delegation_ownership: Message should include specific action items for James (growth) and Emma (content) with clear ownership.
scoring_hints.communication_clarity: Should reference specific numbers from the analysis, not vague 'improve performance'.

turns.user_input: One more thing — check the content calendar and make sure we have the enterprise auth launch covered in April.

scoring_hints.information_synthesis: Should identify that the content calendar has 'API v3 preview' in Week 1 but no specific enterprise auth launch content. Should flag this gap.
